description: Defines the class I18NTranslationSearchFilterParams used for filtering translation search results in the OrangeHRM system, including properties for language ID, source text, translated text, group ID, and translation status.

classes.name: I18NTranslationSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for specifying search filters related to internationalization translation entries, including language ID, source text, translated text, group ID, and whether only translated entries should be included.

methods.name: getLanguageId
methods.description: Returns the language ID used for filtering translations.

methods.name: setLanguageId
methods.description: Sets the language ID used for filtering translations.

methods.name: getSourceText
methods.description: Returns the source text filter value.

methods.name: setSourceText
methods.description: Sets the source text filter value.

methods.name: getTranslatedText
methods.description: Returns the translated text filter value.

methods.name: setTranslatedText
methods.description: Sets the translated text filter value.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the group ID filter value.

methods.name: setGroupId
methods.description: Sets the group ID filter value.

methods.name: getOnlyTranslated
methods.description: Returns whether only translated entries are included.

methods.name: setOnlyTranslated
methods.description: Sets whether to include only translated entries.
